description:
Looking for hungry TikTok and Instagram creators ready to grow with a fast-scaling viral wellness brand.

LUYUMEA is a premium wearable wellness & beauty brand focused on self-care, glow, confidence, energy, and longevity for modern women.

Our hero product — the NAD+ Boost Patch — is a highly visual, TikTok-friendly wellness product designed for lifestyle, beauty, anti-aging, productivity, self-care, and glow-up content.

We are currently building our early creator team before aggressive scale.

Why creators love working with LUYUMEA:

• Up to 40% commission per confirmed order
• High AOV + strong earning potential
• Viral TikTok-friendly wellness/beauty angle
• Long cookie duration for recurring earnings
• Bonus opportunities for top-performing creators
• Long-term partnership potential
• Priority support for serious creators
• Premium gifted products available for selected creators

We provide creators with:

• Viral hooks & content ideas
• Winning marketing angles
• Trend-focused concepts
• Support & fast communication
• Long-term scaling opportunities

Our products are easy to create content around:

• Morning routines
• Wellness & self-care habits
• Glow-up transformations
• Anti-aging routines
• Beauty/lifestyle content
• Productivity routines
• “Day in my life” TikTok videos
• UGC/Testimonial content

We are looking for creators who:
• post consistently
• want long-term growth
• are motivated to scale
• love beauty, wellness, anti-aging, self-care, biohacking, or lifestyle content

⚡ Early creators will receive priority onboarding, bonus opportunities, and long-term scaling support as the brand grows.

Let’s build something huge together.
payout_period: Commissions are reviewed every Monday and processed within the same payout week for verified eligible orders. Top affiliates may qualify for priority payouts, bonuses, gifted products, and long-term collaborations.
